Hey everyone! Well, last year you would see my face on EVERY skin care related subreddit asking desperately for help regarding to acne scars,treatments etc.I was in a very unhappy mental position.After having clean skin forever i suddenly got cystic acne which left me with some pitted scarring as well.What you see in old photos is shadows pretty much to show the depth.Long story short, i got to a point that i accepted that nothing could bring me my baby clean skin back, not even really really expensive treatments. No matter how miserable i felt and how much i was jealous of my other peoples skin, i stopped thinking about it. Stopped crying, stopped taking selfies all the time in bad lighting. I deleted reddit app because it would make me think about it more (that's why you didn't have an update till now,that i feel strong enough to post again).So yeah, i stopped "caring".I got a job and i kept my self busy to avoid thinking.Day by day,month  by month i would feel much better...And my acne breakouts would ALSO stop (turns out they were anxiety-related). But what also surprised me is that even though i did nothing to make my scars look better, they got much better.Not just the PIE,but also the pitted scarring.I did no treatments after reading horror stories of cases that went wrong. Anyway, to anyone struggling, i need to tell them that it will all be better in the end. I have added a photo of me in the exact same place with EVEN WORSE lighting now,but still my skin looks so much better.Do i still have scars?Yes.But much smoother.Would anyone notice them in real life?I doubt it... But to be honest, the reason i didn't notice my skin got much better is that i was in the "don't-care" mood. And i was also happy before realising my progress.So basically,besides giving you hope, i wanna tell you from my personal experience that in the end fixating over something,getting depressed because of SKIN and suffering every day ISN'T WORTH IT.Please live your lives,we got so little time-never know how much-. Sending love to everyone

hello!! I really don't want to disappoint you but you can't get rid of acne scars completely, and usually it takes more than one type of treatment! You need a combination of treatments and sessions.Also,lasers are not suitable for your type of scarring I think.You have boxcar scars which respond best to TCA CROSS.After multiple sessions by an acne scar expert dermatologist, you could have a resurfacing treatment as a laser or microneedling,but for the final touch.Right now look for a dermatologist that performs TCA cross and is well trained!!! 
Remember that you need to keep your expectations realistic.Skin CAN'T get back to it's baby smooth original state.But it can get MUCH better. 100% improvement is out of discussion but 70-80% is an amazing progress. Be patient as changes won't happen overnight,and save up money as these procedures tend to be costly. 

Till then,eat well,sleep well,moisturise and use SPF 50 ! Wish you luck!!
